§6P-Type Wafer Doping§f

§aHole-rich silicon made by bombarding wafers with Boron-11 ions. Yes, really.§f

P-Type Doped Silicon is produced in a Target Chamber. Feed a Silicon Wafer and a Boron-11 ion beam (minimum 600 keV energy, focus 2.0) into the chamber and out comes P-Type silicon.

You need Diborane fluid piped into an Ion Source to generate the Boron-11 beam, then a LINAC with enough RF cavities and magnets to reach the energy threshold. Use the Beam Meter to verify.

P-Type is required for Advanced Processors, which unlock ring accelerators and all the high-tier multiblocks. There is no shortcut for this one.

§cWARNING:§f The beam must meet BOTH the 600 keV energy AND focus 2.0 thresholds or the Target Chamber rejects it. Check your beam before you wonder why nothing is happening.
